name: Chat & Agent Usability
description: Verify AI chat quality and agent usability across all pages. Chat resume works. Each department agent responds on-topic. Agent cards show descriptions. Chat history with proper titles. Metric drill-down dialogs.
acceptanceCriteria: T-019.AC1: AI Chat resume: click history item → previous messages load in chat window
T-019.AC2: AI Chat: ask dealership-specific question → response uses org context
T-019.AC3: Sales Data Guru: ask about leads → returns real VIN data
T-019.AC4: Sales Coach: ask coaching question → relevant advice
T-019.AC5: Communication Writer: request email draft → formatted email response
T-019.AC6: Service Nancy: ask about campaigns → references campaign scheduling
T-019.AC7: Marketing agents: each of 5 agents responds with domain-relevant content
T-019.AC8: Chat history shows 'Chat — X ago' format (not username)
T-019.AC9: All agent cards across Sales/Service/Marketing show name + description
